description: READ PAGES NOW, no browser session: one page (url), up to 20 pages in parallel (urls), or a listing plus its top N item pages (url + top_n). Returns clean markdown in 2-10 s, including pages a plain fetch cannot read: rendered by JavaScript (render_mode='browser'; a read that only got the page's shell says so and gives the retry), behind a bot wall or 403 (an automatic residential retry), or behind the user's sign-in (persona_id). Discussion threads keep their comments. format='html' returns the raw HTML for selectors. NOT FOR: a site-wide dataset (writ_crawl_site) or clicking and typing (writ_browser_use).

persona_id.description: Read signed in as this saved identity (writ_personas).

render_mode.description: auto (default: HTTP, a browser when the page needs JS) | http | browser.

top_n.description: With url = a listing: also read its N top-ranked item pages (max 20).

urls.description: Up to 20 known pages, read in parallel.

use_residential.description: Residential network for a bot wall (automatic retry when refused).

name: writ_scrape
title: Read web pages
